'''M13''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Repair Station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mycroft]] in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. The structure was built in an area of low, [[Forest/Legends|forested]] [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] on the planet. The Empire built M13 to give support, in the form of repairing and refueling, to Imperial [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] operating on the fringes of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Only ships small enough to land on the planet could be serviced, typically [[Scout ship/Legends|scout]] and [[Picket ship/Legends|picket ships]].<ref name="Assault" /> The station had berthing facilities to handle twelve [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], six one-person [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ships]], and two multi-[[Star system/Legends|system]] [[Patrol boat/Legends|patrol boats]].<ref name="Assault-CC">{{WEGCite|story=Assault on Repair Station M13 (adventure)|book=Classic Campaigns}}</ref>

M13 was staffed by around thirty personnel, including [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]], [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]], [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]], and various other support personnel. Twenty [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were assigned to the outpost to defend it. The base complement was sometimes augmented by the crews of Imperial vessels for shore leave while their ships were being repaired, and occasional civilian was known to be allowed into the outpost. The base's warehouses contained general supplies as well as [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], ammunition, [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], and ship parts.<ref name="Assault" />

The installation was protected by a [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] stationed in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], as well as TIE fighters berthed at the outpost itself. The stormtrooper complement had three armed [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] at their disposal, as well as a number of [[reconnaissance droid]]s. The entire outpost was circled by an [[electric fence]] which was designed to deter the predators in the local area from encroaching on the base. In the event of an attack that would cause the base to be overrun by the enemy, a [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]] could be armed and triggered.<ref name="Assault" />

M13 was a target of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lens Reekeene]]'s [[Operation Retribution]]. A [[Green squad|team]] was sent there to [[Assault on Repair Station M13|harass]] the base, capture [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], steal vital equipment, and ultimately destroy the base if possible. In order for the attack to be successful, Reekeene also attacked a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in another system so that the frigate and fighters protecting M13 would be redeployed there, reducing its protection.<ref name="Assault" />
